phoneLowMipCorrection.problem: A 512 cap selected the 256-pixel coast mip because the next cooked level is padded to 513. Raising the override to 1024, equal to the normal cap, omitted smaller levels and exceeded every district 2 MiB budget.
phoneLowMipCorrection.correction: Use a 768 phone-low cap, below the normal 1024 cap but above the padded 513 level, so the cooker emits and selects the approximately 512 logical pixel alternative.
phoneLowMipCorrection.budgetVerification: Passed after fresh Android cook; see memory.json. Districts 0.88–0.94 MiB / 2 MiB, shared 1.929 MiB / 2 MiB, scenario peak 38.203 MiB / 48 MiB.
